findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_coverage_stats, get_threads, get_event_stack, get_blocs · Private data: search_events, get_event, get_connections, get_actors, get_coverage_stats, get_blocs, get_metrics, get_commitments · Public sink: query_scp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_coverage_stats, get_threads, get_event_stack, get_blocs · Private data: search_events, get_event, get_connections, get_actors, get_coverage_stats, get_blocs, get_metrics, get_commitments · Public sink: query_scp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
